summary: The last-step corpse post-effect reaches the missing whole sit.c:attrcurse function. Its rnd(11)=4 falls through to the Rogue’s intrinsic stealth at case 9, clearing only that intrinsic, printing “You feel clumsy.”, and returning STEALTH. The frozen JS cpostfx branch records note_unported("sit.c attrcurse"), so it skips the draw and effect. Four C call sites share attrcurse; throne, angry-god, and monster-attack callers also need their source behavior wired.

source.branch: Port all of sit.c:attrcurse (640-762). It draws rnd(11), then visits cases 1 through 11 in order with source fallthrough, removing the first present intrinsic among fire resistance, teleportation, poison resistance, telepathy, cold resistance, invisibility, see invisible, speed, stealth, protection, or aggravate monster. It clears only the INTRINSIC bit, emits the case message, and returns the property enum; it returns 0 if no listed intrinsic can be removed. Telepathy and see-invisible removal include their source-specific visibility updates; see-invisible feedback also depends on hallucination. In this case rnd(11)=4 starts at telepathy and falls through to case 9 because the Rogue has no earlier removable intrinsic in that range and does have intrinsic stealth; it clears HStealth, emits “You feel clumsy.”, and returns STEALTH.
callers: C eat.c:cpostfx (1270-1275) calls attrcurse after a PM_DISENCHANTER corpse and discards its return. In frozen JS, eat.js:doeat reaches cpostfx (2466), whose PM_DISENCHANTER branch at 2634-2636 records note_unported("sit.c attrcurse") instead of calling it; this is the assigned mismatch.

C sit.c:throne_sit_effect (case 7, 281-285) calls attrcurse and then prints the throne-amusement message. Frozen JS reaches sit.js:throne_sit_effect through dosit at 808-810 but has no attrcurse call; its case 7 branch at 336-350 currently summons court, so this direct production caller is not wired to the C effect.

C pray.c:angrygods (cases 4-5, 752-759) evaluates rn2(2) || !attrcurse(), then calls rndcurse when the left side is true or attrcurse returns 0. The return value and C short-circuit order matter. Frozen JS pray.js:angrygods (2081) throws UnsupportedPrayerError for cases 4-5 at 2130-2132 instead of making either call.

C uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_curs (3057) passes attrcurse’s return to mon_give_prop during the gremlin curse attack against the hero. Frozen JS uhitm.js routes AD_CURS to unported("mhitm_ad_curs") at 3766, so the caller is not wired.
dependencies: Use the game’s source-ordered rnd(11) draw and preserve its position relative to every caller’s other draws.

Read and update the intrinsic property bits represented by HFire_resistance, HTeleportation, HPoison_resistance, HTelepat, HCold_resistance, HInvis, HSee_invisible, HFast, HStealth, HProtection, and HAggravate_monster; clear INTRINSIC only and return the matching property enum.
Preserve the You_feel, You, and Your messages and the Blind, Blind_telepat, See_invisible, and Hallucination conditions.

The telepathy branch calls see_monsters when the hero is blind and loses the only telepathy source. The see-invisible branch calls set_mimic_blocking, see_monsters, and newsym(u.ux,u.uy) when losing the final see-invisible source.
Wire all four callers with their source return-value handling: eat.c and sit.c discard it; pray.c uses it in a short-circuit condition before rndcurse; uhitm.c passes it to mon_give_prop.
